scope: Campaign Evolved UE5.5 packages decoded with the selected USMAP
policy: A value is editable only when Chimp has a typed decoder, validator, symmetric writer, and reopen coverage. Unknown bytes remain read-only and byte-preserved.

evidence.no_op_control: write -> reopen -> write reaches identical bytes, so an edit that reads back is distinguishable from a writer that rearranged the header around it
evidence.header_round_trips: name rename, import retarget and export metadata each survive a package write and reopen
evidence.corpus_controls: run against a Campaign Evolved install: imports::corpus reproduced all four import arrays for 12329 of 12329 shipped tag packages (8733 of them carrying package imports), and name_map::corpus renamed an entry in all 12329, wrote, reopened, and found exactly the one entry changed with every FMappedName still resolving

property_coverage.object_references: editable_as_package_index; searchable cross-package rebinding remains tracked
